title: Bedrock Knowledge Base + OpenSearch Vector Index Setup
description: Set up Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases backed by OpenSearch Service for semantic RAG search.

steps.action: Create OpenSearch Serverless collection (type=VECTORSEARCH) with encryption and network policies
steps.verify: Collection status = Active; endpoint URL available

steps.action: Create vector index in OpenSearch: PUT /bedrock-kb-index with knn_vector field (1024 dims for Titan Embeddings v2)
steps.verify: GET /bedrock-kb-index/_mapping shows knn_vector field with dimension=1024

steps.action: Create S3 data source bucket; upload documents (PDF, HTML, text) to be indexed by Knowledge Base
steps.verify: aws s3 ls s3://<kb-bucket>/ shows all documents; bucket policy allows Bedrock service role

steps.action: Create Bedrock Knowledge Base: Bedrock console → Knowledge bases → Create → select Titan Embeddings V2, OpenSearch collection, S3 data source
steps.verify: Knowledge base status = Active; sync job completes with 0 failed documents

steps.action: Test retrieval: Bedrock console → Test Knowledge Base → enter natural language query
steps.verify: Returns top-3 relevant document excerpts with S3 source URIs; relevance score > 0.7

steps.action: Integrate Knowledge Base ID into application: replace Elasticsearch query calls with Bedrock RetrieveAndGenerate API
steps.verify: Application search returns semantically relevant results; latency p99 < 3s
steps.rollback: Revert to OpenSearch keyword search client
